description: Replace the list of other projects (paid work, other products, life routines), so their sessions count as other work or life, not goal work. Pass the whole list: leave one out to remove it, change its name or hints to edit it. Pass existing ids to keep them. wip_hashtag ties a project to its WIP project (list_wip_projects shows the user's). public: true only when the user says they build this project in public: its sessions with a real summary, and its moves, then go to WIP automatically 10 minutes later unless cancelled (Pro, WIP connected).

public.description: the user builds it in public: its work posts to WIP automatically, with 10 minutes to cancel. Only when the user says so. Leave it out to keep the one on record; default false

wip_hashtag.description: the user's WIP (wip.co) project hashtag for this work, with or without "#"; WIP todos about it carry it. Leave it out to keep the one on record; null or "" removes it
